rule: logical = at least one example task's answer changed. noise = at least one touched example, all touched examples unchanged, and every example in the packet is touched, no prior change that moved an outcome. ambiguous = no example shows a change and no touched example proves nothing changed, or the evidence is mixed, or the coverage is partial: at least one touched example unchanged and at least one untouched example in the packet.

H4-N1.why: Note order changes, but the checker ignores order. Both touched examples keep the same answer, and every example is touched.

H4-N2.why: Dates gain a written format, but the checker reads both as the same date. Both touched examples keep the same answer, and every example is touched.

H4-L1.why: Extra spaces are no longer ignored. The Adele with a trailing space example flips from solved to NOT solved.

H4-L2.why: Totals must now be exact, no rounding. The 12.50 rounded to 13 example flips from solved to NOT solved.

H4-N3.why: Times switch to 24-hour, but the checker reads both formats as the same time. Both touched examples keep the same answer, and every example is touched. The prior is noise from the H4-N1 run.

H4-L3.why: The text says wording cleanup, but a contact must now be found by full name. The first-name-only example flips from solved to NOT solved. The noise prior is misleading.

H4-A1.why: Amounts may switch to euros, but the only example is a count, not an amount, and untouched. Thin evidence, proves nothing either way.

H4-A2.why: Tasks may switch to French, but both examples are counts, untouched. The priors conflict, one noise and one logical, both from real earlier runs in this test.

H4-A3.why: Only calendar changes, email does not. The calendar example is touched and unchanged, the email example is untouched. Partial coverage, proves nothing about calendar locations.

H4-A4.why: Only notes change, files do not. The note example is touched and unchanged, the file example is untouched. Partial coverage, and a prior similar strict rule moved an outcome.
